hypothesis: Explicit calendar-valid unambiguous full dates can normalize independently of quantities, while exact date mutations and evidence-only literal laundering fail the same source gate used by candidates and gold.

data.additionalData: New independently authored deterministic numerical/role fixtures; no protected corpus or model output used for tuning.

hardGates: Gregorian-valid ISO dates and dotted day>12/month/year converge without locale guesses.
Dates remain separate exact literals; changed dates and missing quantities cannot be hidden by component numbers.
Only identity-bearing semantic fields satisfy literal retention; evidence remains recoverable but does not rescue an omitted literal.
No Sem, registry, frame or fingerprint projection changes; previously retained unchanged representations keep their fingerprints.
Candidate identity is not semantic correctness or trust promotion.
Ambiguous/invalid/partial dates receive no guessed normalization.
New versioned runtime package supersedes but never edits v15 or historical evidence.
Full verification and deliberate weakening sensitivity before publication.
nonClaims: No general semantic fidelity, native review, live parser accuracy or deployed privacy/storage behavior.
Role binding, literal frequency, spelled-out dates and unit conversions remain outside this floor.
